title: Federated Learning for the Design of Parametric Insurance Indices under Heterogeneous Renewable Production Losses
abstract: arXiv:2601.12178v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a federated learning framework for the calibration of parametric insurance indices under heterogeneous renewable energy production losses. Producers locally model their losses using Tweedie generalized linear models and private data, while a common index is learned through federated optimization without sharing raw observations. The approach accommodates heterogeneity in variance and link functions and directly minimizes a global deviance objective in a distributed setting. We establish theoretical guarantees under sub-exponential covariate distributions, showing that the Lipschitz constants of the local Tweedie objectives scale as $\frac{1}{\phi_i}$, where $\phi_i$ is the dispersion parameter of producer $i$. translated_title: 异构可再生能源生产损失下参数化保险指数的联邦学习设计
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种联邦学习框架，用于在异构可再生能源生产损失下校准参数化保险指数。生产者使用Tweedie广义线性模型和私有数据在本地建模其损失，而通过联邦优化学习一个共同指数，无需共享原始观测数据。该方法适应方差和链接函数的异质性，并在分布式环境中直接最小化全局偏差目标。我们在亚指数协变量分布下建立了理论保证，表明本地Tweedie目标的Lipschitz常数按$\frac{1}{\phi_i}$缩放，其中$\phi_i$是生产者$i$的离散参数。这种平滑度的异质性导致朴素联邦平均偏向于具有稳定微气候的生产者——恰恰是那些最不需要基差风险保护的生产者——并促使使用校正方法。
tldr: 本文提出一种联邦学习框架，用于在异构可再生能源损失下设计参数化保险指数，并理论证明平滑度异质性会导致联邦平均偏倚，需采用校正方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a federated learning framework for designing parametric insurance indices under heterogeneous renewable energy losses, theoretically showing that smoothness heterogeneity biases federated averaging and necessitates correction methods.
